reason: We do library storytime, parks, the zoo and church groups, and my kid is happy there for free. Paying $59 a month for something that sounds like CoCo's Funhouse with nicer decor is hard to justify when I already have a full week of free stuff.
objection: Why pay every month for indoor play when the library, parks and church group cost nothing? I'd need a reason this is different from CoCo's.
would_change_my_mind: A free or very cheap trial visit, or a free community story time there, that showed my kid really wanted to go back.
